highlights.title_zh: EEG-benchmark：四个标准实验范式的 PsychoPy 实现（含触发器与显示说明）
highlights.title_en: EEG-benchmark: PsychoPy Implementations of Four Standard EEG Paradigms
highlights.brief: 新建仓库 EEG-benchmark（2026-10-19）把四个标准 EEG 实验范式做成可直接运行的 PsychoPy 工程：睁眼/闭眼静息（EOEC）、四目标 SSVEP、以及来自 ERP CORE 的 N170 面孔知觉与 Flanker 任务，每个目录各自附**实验设计、触发器映射、数据与显示器说明**，并明确以固定 60 Hz 刷新率为前提做标定。它的价值在于「共享的不只是代码」——范式复现最容易出错的恰恰是触发码时序与显示参数，而这类信息通常在论文里被省略。对需要搭采集流程的实验室、或想把公开数据（ERP CORE、SSVEP 基准）在自己的设备上重跑一遍的团队，这是省时且降低踩坑率的起点。

highlights.title_zh: eeg-motor-intent-decoder：30 通道脑电的 brain-switch，含漂移与混淆控制、实时 LSL 回放
highlights.title_en: eeg-motor-intent-decoder: A 30-Channel Brain-Switch with Drift and Confound Controls plus LSL Replay
highlights.brief: 新建仓库 eeg-motor-intent-decoder（2026-10-19）做的是「brain-switch」式运动意图解码：从 30 通道 EEG 判别 Idle／Push／Walk 三类，方法上同时给出 Riemann/CSP 与 EEGNet 两类基线，并按「无泄漏」协议评估，额外加入 **drift-null 与混淆控制**。最后两项很值得注意——EEG 闭环实验里，信号漂移与标签/流程混淆是最容易把准确率抬高的因素，作者主动把它们作为对照，比单纯报一个高指标可信得多。仓库还提供实时 **LSL 回放**路径，便于在没有被试时复跑在线流程。对做康复/助行类 BCI 原型的团队，这是一份结构完整、可直接对照的工程范本；仍属硕士项目级，临床结论需另做验证。

highlights.title_zh: braindecode 修幅度归因中梯度被清零，并为 ZUNA 加上 Gaudi 融合 RoPE
highlights.title_en: braindecode Preserves Gradients in Amplitude Attribution and Adds Gaudi Fused RoPE to ZUNA
highlights.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 19 日推进 5 次提交，最需要留意的是 **#1469：修掉幅度归因（amplitude attribution）过程中模型梯度被破坏**的问题。归因/显著图若在梯度被清零或改写的情况下计算，图会失真甚至方向相反——而这类「解释」常被直接用于论文配图与神经生理学解读，错误很隐蔽。其余提交偏性能与可用性：ZUNA 的 rotary embedding 改走 Gaudi 融合 RoPE 内核（#1461）、新增 `registers` 选项（#1468）、AugmentedDataLoader 对改变形状的变换给出清晰 ValueError。对用归因方法解释 EEG 模型的团队，建议升级后重跑既有显著图并与旧结果比对。

items.title_zh: EEG-benchmark：四个标准实验范式的 PsychoPy 实现（含触发器与显示说明）
items.title_en: EEG-benchmark: PsychoPy Implementations of Four Standard EEG Paradigms
bullets_zh: 四个可直接运行的心理物理任务：`01-EOEC`（睁眼/闭眼静息）、`02-SSVEP`（四目标 SSVEP）、`03-Face`（ERP CORE N170 面孔知觉）、`04-Flanker`（ERP CORE Flanker）。
每个实验目录各自带设计、**触发器（trigger）**、数据与显示器说明，并以固定 60 Hz 刷新率为前提标定——这正是实验复现最常被忽略的两个环节。
环境约定 Python 3.11；仓库约 13 MB，含 requirements.txt，属「克隆即可用于采集」的工程化范式集合。
bullets_en: Four runnable psychophysics tasks: 01-EOEC (eyes-open/closed resting), 02-SSVEP (four-target SSVEP), 03-Face (ERP CORE N170 face perception) and 04-Flanker (ERP CORE Flanker).
Each experiment folder carries its own design, trigger, data and display documentation, calibrated for a fixed 60 Hz refresh rate — the two details most often missing from shared paradigms.
Python 3.11, about 13 MB with requirements.txt: a paradigm collection you can clone and use for acquisition.
items.brief: 新建仓库 EEG-benchmark（2026-10-19）把四个标准 EEG 实验范式做成可直接运行的 PsychoPy 工程：睁眼/闭眼静息（EOEC）、四目标 SSVEP、以及来自 ERP CORE 的 N170 面孔知觉与 Flanker 任务，每个目录各自附**实验设计、触发器映射、数据与显示器说明**，并明确以固定 60 Hz 刷新率为前提做标定。它的价值在于「共享的不只是代码」——范式复现最容易出错的恰恰是触发码时序与显示参数，而这类信息通常在论文里被省略。对需要搭采集流程的实验室、或想把公开数据（ERP CORE、SSVEP 基准）在自己的设备上重跑一遍的团队，这是省时且降低踩坑率的起点。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-10-19, EEG-benchmark turns four standard paradigms into runnable PsychoPy projects: eyes-open/closed resting, a four-target SSVEP task, and the ERP CORE N170 face and Flanker tasks. Each folder documents design, trigger mapping, data and display settings, calibrated for a fixed 60 Hz refresh rate — the details usually missing from papers, and the ones that break replication.
items.raw_excerpt: README: "Four windowed PsychoPy experiments configured for a fixed 60 Hz display: `01-EOEC`: eyes-open/eyes-closed resting-state EEG; `02-SSVEP`: four-target SSVEP task; `03-Face`: ERP CORE N170 face-perception task; `04-Flanker`: ERP CORE Flanker task. Each experiment folder contains its own design, trigger, data, and display documentation." Contents: 01-EOEC, 02-SSVEP, 03-Face, 04-Flanker, requirements.txt.
items.why_valuable: 四个标准范式＋触发器与显示说明齐全，直接省掉实验复现最容易踩的两个坑。

items.title_zh: eeg-motor-intent-decoder：30 通道脑电的 brain-switch，含漂移与混淆控制、实时 LSL 回放
items.title_en: eeg-motor-intent-decoder: A 30-Channel Brain-Switch with Drift and Confound Controls plus LSL Replay
bullets_zh: 任务为 Idle／Push／Walk 三类运动意图，30 通道 EEG；方法覆盖 Riemann/CSP 与 EEGNet 两类基线。
明确以「无泄漏」方式评估，并加入 **drift-null 与混淆控制**——这两项在真实闭环里最容易造成指标虚高。
仓库结构完整（data、docs、experiments、models、results、scripts），并提供**实时 LSL 回放**通道，属硕士毕业项目级但工程完成度高。
bullets_en: Idle/Push/Walk motor-intent classes from 30-channel EEG, benchmarked with both Riemann/CSP and EEGNet baselines.
Evaluated without leakage and with drift-null plus confound controls — the two things that most often inflate metrics in real closed loops.
A complete layout (data, docs, experiments, models, results, scripts) with a real-time LSL replay path; a master's final project with unusually solid engineering.
items.brief: 新建仓库 eeg-motor-intent-decoder（2026-10-19）做的是「brain-switch」式运动意图解码：从 30 通道 EEG 判别 Idle／Push／Walk 三类，方法上同时给出 Riemann/CSP 与 EEGNet 两类基线，并按「无泄漏」协议评估，额外加入 **drift-null 与混淆控制**。最后两项很值得注意——EEG 闭环实验里，信号漂移与标签/流程混淆是最容易把准确率抬高的因素，作者主动把它们作为对照，比单纯报一个高指标可信得多。仓库还提供实时 **LSL 回放**路径，便于在没有被试时复跑在线流程。对做康复/助行类 BCI 原型的团队，这是一份结构完整、可直接对照的工程范本；仍属硕士项目级，临床结论需另做验证。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-10-19, eeg-motor-intent-decoder targets brain-switch style intent decoding: Idle/Push/Walk from 30-channel EEG, benchmarked with Riemann/CSP and EEGNet, evaluated without leakage and with drift-null plus confound controls — the factors most likely to inflate closed-loop accuracy — and it ships a real-time LSL replay path for offline validation of online pipelines.
items.raw_excerpt: Description: "Brain-switch BCI from 30-ch EEG: Riemann/CSP + EEGNet, drift-null & confound controls, real-time LSL replay. Master's PFE". README banner: "Idle / Push / Walk from EEG, evaluated without leakage". Contents: data, docs, experiments, models, results, scripts, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt.
items.why_valuable: 主动加入 drift-null 与混淆控制并给出 LSL 回放，评估比只报高指标可信。

items.title_zh: braindecode 修幅度归因中梯度被清零，并为 ZUNA 加上 Gaudi 融合 RoPE
items.title_en: braindecode Preserves Gradients in Amplitude Attribution and Adds Gaudi Fused RoPE to ZUNA
bullets_zh: #1469 修「幅度归因（amplitude attribution）」过程中模型梯度被破坏的问题——归因结果若在梯度被清零的情形下计算，解释会失真甚至反向。
#1461 让 ZUNA 的 rotary embedding 走 Gaudi 融合 RoPE 内核（HPU）；#1468 新增 `registers` 选项（False 表示编码器只作用于 patch token）。
另修 AugmentedDataLoader 下会改变形状的变换未给出清晰 ValueError 的问题，便于在数据增强配置错误时快速定位。
bullets_en: #1469 fixes model gradients being clobbered during amplitude attribution, which would make attribution maps wrong or even inverted.
#1461 routes ZUNA's rotary embedding through Gaudi's fused RoPE kernel on HPU, and #1468 adds a registers option (False keeps the encoder on patch tokens only).
It also raises a clear ValueError for shape-changing transforms in AugmentedDataLoader, so augmentation misconfiguration surfaces immediately.
items.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 19 日推进 5 次提交，最需要留意的是 **#1469：修掉幅度归因（amplitude attribution）过程中模型梯度被破坏**的问题。归因/显著图若在梯度被清零或改写的情况下计算，图会失真甚至方向相反——而这类「解释」常被直接用于论文配图与神经生理学解读，错误很隐蔽。其余提交偏性能与可用性：ZUNA 的 rotary embedding 改走 Gaudi 融合 RoPE 内核（#1461）、新增 `registers` 选项（#1468）、AugmentedDataLoader 对改变形状的变换给出清晰 ValueError。对用归因方法解释 EEG 模型的团队，建议升级后重跑既有显著图并与旧结果比对。
items.brief_en: braindecode made five commits on Oct 19, the one to note is #1469: model gradients were being clobbered during amplitude attribution, which makes attribution maps wrong or inverted — dangerous because such maps are routinely used in papers and neurophysiological interpretation. Also ZUNA's rotary embedding now uses Gaudi's fused RoPE kernel (#1461) and a registers option (#1468).
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-10-19: "FIX Preserve model gradients during amplitude attribution (#1469)" 08:26Z; "ZUNA: rotary embedding through Gaudi's fused RoPE kernel on HPU (#1461)" 08:28Z; "ZUNA: registers option (False = encoder on the patch tokens only) (#1468)" 08:26Z; "Clear ValueError for shape-changing transforms in AugmentedDataLoader…" 08:26Z.
items.why_valuable: 归因图若在梯度被破坏下计算会失真反向，直接影响论文级解释结果的可靠性。

items.title_zh: MOABB 继续把数据集取数迁到 NEMAR，并给 Lenaig2026 改名留弃用别名
items.title_en: MOABB Keeps Migrating Datasets to NEMAR and Renames Lenaig2026 with a Deprecated Alias
bullets_zh: #1319 把 Lenaig2026 更名为 Gueho2026，并保留弃用别名；同时新增 class-name 审计元数据，便于追踪历史命名。
#1315／#1316／#1317／#1314 继续把 BI2013a、Mainsah2025、Castillos2023、Chang2025 的取数改为优先用 NEMAR 存储（提取好的 runs、store provenance 的文件清单、共享 4Class-CVEP 树等）。
取数来源改变会影响下载量与可复现性；命名变更则可能让既有脚本静默指向旧类名。
bullets_en: #1319 renames Lenaig2026 to Gueho2026 while keeping a deprecated alias and adds class-name audit metadata for tracking historical names.
#1315/#1316/#1317/#1314 continue moving BI2013a, Mainsah2025, Castillos2023 and Chang2025 to prefer NEMAR storage (extracted runs, store-provenance file lists, the shared 4Class-CVEP tree).
Changing data sources affects download volume and reproducibility, while renames can leave old scripts silently pointing at a stale class name.
items.brief: MOABB 在 10 月 19 日推进 13 次提交，两条线并行：①**数据源迁到 NEMAR**——BI2013a 改用 NEMAR 沉积里已提取的 runs、Mainsah2025 从 store provenance 取文件清单再做 SHA 校验、Castillos2023 优先取共享的 4Class-CVEP 树、Chang2025 匹配 MNE-chang2025-data/ 前缀；②**命名治理**——Lenaig2026 更名为 Gueho2026 并保留弃用别名，同时新增 class-name 审计元数据记录历史命名。对使用者，前者改善下载稳定性，后者意味着旧脚本可能仍能跑（别名）但语义已变；建议升级后确认自己引用的类名与数据来源，并重跑关键结果。
items.brief_en: MOABB made 13 commits on Oct 19 along two lines: more datasets prefer the NEMAR store (BI2013a's extracted runs, Mainsah2025's file lists with SHA checks, Castillos2023's shared 4Class-CVEP tree), and naming governance — Lenaig2026 became Gueho2026 with a deprecated alias plus class-name audit metadata. Old scripts may still run but mean something different.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-10-19: "Rename Lenaig2026 to Gueho2026 (deprecated alias) + class-name audit metadata (#1319)" 20:58Z; "Castillos2023: take the shared 4Class-CVEP tree from the NEMAR store before do[wnloading] (#1317)" 20:34Z; "Mainsah2025: take the file list from the store provenance before fetching SHA2[56] (#1316)" 19:51Z; "BI2013a: use the extracted runs from the NEMAR deposit (#1315)" 18:58Z.
items.why_valuable: 取数迁 NEMAR 更稳，且改名保留别名——旧脚本能跑但语义变了，需复核。

items.title_zh: EEGDash 支持 S3 对象版本固定，并可从截断的 EEGLAB 沉积中读取已验证样本
items.title_en: EEGDash Pins Per-Record S3 Versions and Reads Verified Samples from Truncated Deposits
bullets_zh: #485 支持按记录粒度固定 S3 对象版本（object version pin），避免上游覆盖同名对象后历史结果静默改变。
#486 从被截断的 EEGLAB 沉积中读取**已验证样本**（而不是整段失败或读到不完整数据）；#484 保留含不支持 BIDS 实体的原始文件。
同一批还新增 iEEG 解剖电极标签的元数据暴露（仅标签型数据集），属数据描述能力扩展。
bullets_en: #485 honours per-record S3 object version pins, so an upstream overwrite of a same-named object cannot silently change historical results.
#486 reads verified samples from truncated EEGLAB deposits instead of failing the whole record or returning partial data, and #484 preserves exact files with unsupported BIDS entities.
The same batch also surfaces iEEG anatomical electrode labels for labels-only datasets, extending metadata coverage.
items.brief: EEGDash 在 10 月 19 日推进 12 次提交，核心是**可复现性**：#485 支持按记录固定 S3 对象版本（version pin），这样即使上游把同名对象覆盖，历史结果也不会静默变化——对大规模开放数据平台，这比任何新功能都重要；#486 从被截断的 EEGLAB 沉积中读取已验证样本（既不整段失败，也不把不完整数据当好数据）；#484 保留含不支持 BIDS 实体的原始文件，避免入库时丢文件。另有 iEEG 解剖电极标签的元数据暴露（仅标签型数据集）。对依赖 EEGDash 做批处理或元分析的团队，版本固定后应把 pin 值记录进自己的实验配置，才能真正做到「重跑得到同一结果」。
items.brief_en: EEGDash made 12 commits on Oct 19 centred on reproducibility: #485 pins per-record S3 object versions so upstream overwrites cannot silently change historical results, #486 reads verified samples from truncated EEGLAB deposits without failing whole records, and #484 preserves files with unsupported BIDS entities.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-10-19: "fix(download): honor per-record S3 object version pins (#485)" 14:43Z; "fix(io): read verified samples from truncated EEGLAB deposits (#486)" 14:50Z; "fix(dataset): preserve exact files with unsupported BIDS entities (#484)" 14:18Z; "feat(dataset): surface iEEG anatomical electrode labels (labels-only dataset…)" 13:41Z.
items.why_valuable: 按记录固定 S3 版本，避免上游覆盖导致历史结果静默变化，是复现的关键一步。

items.title_zh: MNELAB 1.7.1：重采样支持 NaN，并可用复选框批量选通道/事件/标注
items.title_en: MNELAB 1.7.1: Resampling Now Handles NaNs and Checkbox Selection for Channels/Events
bullets_zh: #719 修复重采样在含 **NaN** 的数据上失败的问题（EEG 中坏段常被置 NaN，此前必须先插值或剔除）。
通道、事件类型与标注类型均可用复选框选择，Shift 点击可连选范围、表头复选框可全选（#718）。
另含 macOS 原生窗口背景等外观调整，版本于 10-19 发布（v1.7.1），紧随 1.7.0 之后。
bullets_en: #719 fixes resampling failing on data containing NaNs, which is common when bad segments are marked as NaN and previously required interpolation or removal first.
Channels, event types and annotation types can be selected with checkboxes, with Shift-click for ranges and a header checkbox for all (#718).
It also includes macOS native window-background polish; v1.7.1 shipped on Oct 19, right after 1.7.0.
items.brief: MNELAB 发布 1.7.1（2026-10-19），最实用的一条是 **#719：重采样现在能处理含 NaN 的数据**。EEG 预处理里常用 NaN 标记坏段（如电极脱落、大伪迹），此前一旦数据里有 NaN，重采样会失败或需要先插值/剔除，打乱流程；修好后可以直接在保留坏段标记的前提下改变采样率。另一项是交互改进：通道、事件类型、标注类型都支持复选框选择，Shift 点击连选、表头一键全选（#718），对几十上百通道的数据集批量操作省事不少。紧随 1.7.0 发布，属快速修复版。
items.brief_en: MNELAB 1.7.1 (Oct 19) most usefully fixes resampling on data containing NaNs (#719): since bad segments are often marked NaN, resampling previously failed unless you interpolated or dropped them first. It also adds checkbox selection for channels, event types and annotation types with Shift-click ranges and a select-all header (#718), following quickly after 1.7.0.
items.raw_excerpt: Release v1.7.1 (2026-10-19T11:18:55Z): "Changed — Select channels, event types, and annotation types with checkboxes (Shift-click checks a range, the header checkbox checks all) (#718)"; commits that day include "Fix resampling to work with NaNs (#719)" 09:38Z and "Release 1.7.1".
items.why_valuable: 坏段用 NaN 标记后可直接重采样，不必再插值或剔除，流程更顺。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 修肌电 z-score 标注：坏通道不再参与
items.title_en: MNE-Python Excludes Bad Channels from Muscle z-Score Annotation
bullets_zh: #14418 修 `annotate_muscle_zscore` 未排除坏通道的问题：此前坏导会参与 z-score 统计，导致阈值判断整体偏移。
肌电伪迹标注常用于自动识别肌肉活动区段；坏导（高阻、脱落、持续噪声）混入会抬高或压低全局分布。
属单点但影响面广的正确性修复：所有用该函数做自动肌电标注的流程都受影响，建议升级后重跑标注并与人工复核对照。
bullets_en: #14418 stops annotate_muscle_zscore from including bad channels, which previously skewed the z-score distribution and thus the threshold decision.
Muscle-artefact annotation is used to auto-detect EMG bursts; bad channels (high impedance, detached, persistently noisy) distort the global distribution.
A small but wide-reaching correctness fix: any automated muscle annotation built on this function is affected, so re-run and compare with manual review after upgrading.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14418，修掉 `annotate_muscle_zscore` 未排除**坏通道**的问题。该函数通过计算肌电频段包络的 z-score 来自动标注肌肉活动区段；如果坏导（高阻、接触不良、持续噪声）参与统计，全局分布会被拉偏，阈值判断随之整体偏移——表现为「明明没有肌电却被标出来」或「真实肌电被漏掉」。这是典型的单点修复、影响面却很广：所有依赖自动肌电标注的预处理流程都会受影响。建议升级后对既有数据重跑标注，并与人工复核结果对照，确认坏导比例高的数据集差异有多大。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged #14418 so annotate_muscle_zscore excludes bad channels. The function auto-annotates muscle bursts from z-scored EMG-band envelopes, and noisy or detached channels skew the global distribution, shifting the threshold decision — producing false annotations or missing real ones. Any automated muscle annotation built on it should be re-run and compared with manual review.
items.raw_excerpt: Commit 2026-10-19T19:22Z: "BUG: Exclude bad channels in annotate_muscle_zscore (#14418)". Latest release remains v1.13.2 (2026-09-11).
items.why_valuable: 坏导参与统计会让自动肌电标注整体偏移，所有相关流程需重跑对照。

items.title_zh: pyRiemann 让 sample_gaussian 支持按数组 sigma 生成 HPD 矩阵，并修 TLCenter 排序域问题
items.title_en: pyRiemann Generalises sample_gaussian to HPD Matrices and Fixes TLCenter Domain Ordering
bullets_zh: #463 让 `sample_gaussian` 在 sigma 为数组时生成 **HPD（Hermitian 正定）** 矩阵，此前只覆盖 SPD 场景。
#506 修 `TLCenter.transform()` 在 `"last"` 排序下的域顺序处理错误——域顺序错会让中心化参照错位，进而影响迁移结果。
两者都服务于跨域/跨被试的黎曼迁移实验：合成数据生成与中心化是构造与对齐域的两大基础操作。
bullets_en: #463 generalises sample_gaussian to produce HPD (Hermitian positive-definite) matrices when sigma is an array, previously limited to the SPD case.
#506 fixes TLCenter.transform() mishandling domain order under "last" sorting, where a wrong domain order misaligns the centring reference and skews transfer results.
Both serve cross-domain or cross-subject Riemannian transfer, where synthetic sampling and centring are the two foundational operations.
items.brief: pyRiemann 在 10 月 19 日合并两项与迁移学习相关的改动：#463 让 `sample_gaussian` 在 sigma 为数组时生成 **HPD（Hermitian 正定）矩阵**（此前仅覆盖 SPD，复数信号场景受限）；#506 修 `TLCenter.transform()` 在 `"last"` 排序下的**域顺序**处理错误——域顺序一旦错位，中心化参照就错了，跨域迁移的结果会跟着偏，且不会报错。对做黎曼几何跨被试/跨域迁移的团队，这两处都属于「实验能跑但结论可能不对」的类型；建议升级后核对域标签顺序与合成数据的共轭对称性，必要时重跑关键对照。
items.brief_en: pyRiemann merged two transfer-learning changes on Oct 19: #463 lets sample_gaussian produce HPD (Hermitian positive-definite) matrices when sigma is an array, beyond the SPD-only case, and #506 fixes TLCenter.transform() mishandling domain order under "last" sorting — a misordered domain shifts the centring reference and silently skews cross-domain results.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-10-19: "ENH: generalize sample_gaussian to generate HPD matrices for array sigma (#463)" 10:31Z; "Correct transform() of TLCenter used with \"last\" sorting domains by order of f[irst]… (#506)" 10:25Z.
items.why_valuable: 域顺序错位会让中心化参照偏移且不报错，跨域迁移结论可能因此偏差。
